# CrossLayer_SignalRouting

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A technique for routing neural spike signals through multiple topological layers, where each layer applies a different transformation or aggregation. It enables hierarchical processing in hybrid TCC-iNEST systems, mimicking cortical processing while using network-efficient routing.
